UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Isolated private profile metadata for an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in account controls.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

SavedLunarSite.title: SavedLunarSite
SavedLunarSite.description: A user-saved lunar landing coordinate, observation timestamp, and basemap bookmark.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created this lunar waypoint.

name.description: User-assigned name for the lunar site.

elevationM.description: Surface elevation relative to IAU2015_Moon mean radius in meters (-12000 to 20000).

dateTimeUtc.description: UTC date and time string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) for solar illumination & ephemeris.

basemapMode.description: Active basemap mode saved with this site.

notes.description: Optional observation or mission planning notes.

/users/{userId}/private/profile.description: Strictly owner-private profile document storing verified user PII.

/users/{userId}/sites/{siteId}.description: User-owned saved lunar coordinates, UTC observation epoch, and notes.
